prompt:
Repair the deployment manifest compiler in src/. Keep the public compileManifest(documents, entry, env = {}) API and return an array of {id, path} records. Documents are an in-memory object keyed by document name. Each document has optional includes (an array of document names) and artifacts (an array of records with string id, optional string path, and optional boolean disabled). Inputs are well-formed except for the explicitly specified errors below. Do not mutate documents or env.

Expand includes depth-first in listed order, then process the including document's artifacts in listed order. An include may occur multiple times (including diamond graphs); each occurrence participates in precedence. Only a repeated name on the current recursion stack is a cycle. Missing documents throw Error('Unknown manifest: NAME'); cycles throw Error('Manifest cycle: A -> B -> A') with the full traversal stack followed by the repeated name. An own document entry is required; inherited object properties do not count.

Merge by artifact id. The first occurrence fixes that id's output position permanently. Later records replace earlier records without moving the position. A disabled:true record suppresses that id; a later enabled record may restore it at its original position. Disabled records need no path. Resolve and validate paths only for final enabled records, so overridden or disabled invalid paths do not cause errors.

For final enabled artifacts replace every ${NAME} placeholder (NAME matches [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*) using own properties of env, including empty string values. A missing variable throws Error('Missing variable: NAME'). Expansion is single-pass: placeholders introduced by an env value are literal text, not recursively expanded. A missing/non-string path throws Error('Missing path: ID'). Normalize expanded paths using POSIX path rules; reject empty expanded paths, absolute paths, or normalized paths equal to '..' or beginning '../', with Error('Unsafe path: ID'). A normalized '.' is allowed, as are internal parent segments that stay inside the root. Return no fields except id and normalized path. Preserve all existing exports and keep the implementation split across its existing modules. Add regression tests if useful. No dependencies or network; run tests with node --test test/*.test.js.
